استخرجا (form X)
# اِسْتَخْرَجَا (istaḵrajā) /is.tax.ra.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# اُسْتُخْرِجَا (ustuḵrijā) /us.tux.ri.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# اِسْتَخْرِجَا (istaḵrijā) /is.tax.ri.d͡ʒaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
